\chapter{Greedy with Regret}
\label{ch:regret}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{Take the greedy choice now and keep the option to undo it later: regret turns many wrong greedies into right ones.}}
\end{tcolorbox}

\chapterfacts{1800}{2600}{3}{6}{30}

\begin{plannedbox}[Planned Contents --- this chapter is not written yet]
\textbf{Part A --- Lessons}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item Regret: record what each choice could be traded back for
    \item Undo the worst earlier choice when a better one appears (heaps are the stack-queue-heap book)
    \item Refuelling and stops: take fuel only when you must, from the best station passed
    \item Bracket sequences with costs: start cheap, swap when needed
    \item Proving regret greedies with exchange arguments
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Part B --- Patterns} (with candidate problems, checked when the chapter is written)
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{P\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item \textbf{Take only when needed} --- Minimum Number of Refueling Stops {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 871)}
    \item \textbf{Swap a choice for a cheaper one} --- Least Cost Bracket Sequence {\small\color{darkgray}(CF 3D)}
    \item \textbf{Regret with profits}
\end{enumerate}
